reviews.comment: She is the most caring professor I have had so far. It was super easy to schedule a makeup exam. Her exams are not super difficult if you use the cheat sheets to their full potential. She is very open to feedback and super willing to help at all times. Loves her job, and she teaches well.

Professor Trindade is one of the kindest professors I've ever had. She is so friendly and cares deeply for her students. Exams are in-class but online but she allows a cheat sheet. Attendance wasn't mandatory but I definitely recommend going. Would definitely take again!

Perhaps the easiest class of all time. Prof Trindade allowed 2 cheat sheets allowed on every quiz/exam, which are modeled exactly after the practice. Her lectures were sometimes not even needed, because all the information you needed is posted on canvas. She is really kind and caring, and is a full diva when it comes to her outfits.

Dr. Trindade was pretty good. Honestly she is not the best at teaching the material, but she is truly the sweetest lady. There is so much EC (I had 63 points) if you do the homework and go to class. She makes this already easy course even easier with a formula sheet for the 3 quizzes and 3 exams.

Prof. Trindade is the nicest professor you will ever have. She offers a lot of opportunities for extra credit and asks for feedback on her class to make it better/easier. Sometimes it is difficult to understand her accent but as the class goes on you will know what she is saying.

Her class wasn't super difficult, but because of that, it was easy to forget about and accidentally fall behind. As long as you attend each lecture, do the practice quizzes and exams, and make a high quality formula sheet, it shouldn't be difficult to get an A.

Really lovely teacher, very nice, though sometimes her accent makes a few words muddled. Lots of extra credit opportunities, and lots of resources. Practice exams and quizzes are just like the actual thing, and honestly if you understand those you're good to go. Attendance is not mandatory, if you took AP statistics you can self study and get 100s.

This prof is precious. She genuinely wants to help you learn, understand, and love business stats. You have plenty of extra credit and get a cheat sheet that you can put the practice quiz on. She genuinely will accept any recommendations to make the class better for you. Take her you will be blessed.

She is so nice. For Quizzes and Tests you are allowed cheat sheets and calculator of your choice. Go to Class. A lot of material to go over. As long as you go to class and do the practice quizzes and exams you should be fine. She gives lots of Extra credit so do that because the class is weighted by those quizzes and exams.
This professor is amazing. Truly the kindest and most caring. I highly recommend taking her for BUSN 203!

Professor Trindade is incredible. Cheat sheets on quizzes/exams, and her content is very straightforward and formula based. You'll do great as long as you have the right formulas. She offers an insane amount of extra credit, tutoring, and doubts clarification sessions. In general, she is kind, caring, and helpful to students. Highly recommend!

Professor Trinidad is an amazing professor; she gave a lot of extra credit, was always available outside of class, and after class. She also allows cheat sheets on all quizzes and tests. She really cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. Pay attention in class, do the practice quizzes and tests, and this class should be an easy A.
Easiest class I've taken by far. One of the most caring professors I've had. Someone who's terrible at math can get an A in this class.

She is the sweetest person ever, I would take every class with her if I could.  Professor Trindade provides so much extra credit and is always willing to meet with you outside of class if you have any questions.  She is amazing at breaking down hard concepts and doesn't give much work at all.  I adore her and she has an amazing fashion sense.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a very kind person and a wonderful lecturer, and clearly puts effort into her teaching. She also offers a bunch of extra credit which is applicable to the exams, which make up around 90% of the content that is graded. She is accessible outside of class and conveys ideas clearly.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So much extra credit! I did really good on the first two exams so I didn't really try for the final tbh and still got an A thanks to the extra credit so yeah take her!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved her class so much. Attendance is not mandatory and she does post the presentations online. The exams weigh heavily but she gives material to prepare for them. She is very caring and always willing to help!

She is so so sweet, kind, and nice. She always explains everything you need to know. Her lecture is really easy to follow and understand. Her lecture slide has example after every single topic so you can practice. Her exams are easy and her quizzes are even easier. Take her if you can. I really recommend Maria!!!

I love her. Please choose her if you are taking BUSN 203. She is the sweetest lady and always shows up in the cutest outfits to class. She is a kind and caring professor who really loves what she does. She makes sure that we are always doing okay in the class! Lots of bonus points and you can use a cheat sheet on the tests. Take her!

Prof. Trindade is very sweet and understanding. Her exams and quizzes are just like the practice ones in canvas and she gives a letter grade of extra credit. I recommend writing by hand your notes and formulas on the sheet you are provided and you will know the content by heart.

she's super cool and very sweet. honestly didn't always understand her lectures but the content was easy and there's enough extra credit to bump you up a whole letter grade. 3 quizzes (drop lowest) and 3 exams, you use excel for formulas a lot
Insane amount of extra credit. Practice tests are almost the same just different numbers compared to real tests.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is weird but she does a great job teaching it! You get cheat sheets on each exam, and SO much extra credit I will have over a 100. She is the sweetest prof and has great style :) This is not a hard class, and Id recommend her, shes precious.

Does not do a good job explaining reasoning behind calculations. Essentially asks students to plug numbers into formulas without fair explanation as to why. This class was an easy A because of extra credit and the allowance of cheat sheets on exams, but if you actually value learning the concepts, I would take this class with a different professor.

This is by far the best professor to take for BUSN 203. She is so kind and actually cares about all of her students. She gives an easy extra credit assignment almost every week so there is plenty of opportunity to have an A in the class. She gives practice tests before the quizzes and exams that are so similar to the real thing and are so helpful.

By far my favorite professor taken at A&M through 4 semesters. She has extra credit at least once a week, responds to emails very quickly, and wants every student to understand the material. Even as someone who does not enjoy school one bit I looked forward to her class every time.
She is so sweet! I'm so bad at math but still ended with a B+. She has a lot of extra credit opportunities so make sure you take advantage! I loved her.

Very sweet! You can tell she genuinely loves her job and students. One critique, it is difficult to follow her teaching of statistics through PowerPoint because you don't get to work problems out. Personally didn't feel like I learned a lot. But tests are easier than lecture and a lot of extra points. Ended with over 20 pts above 100.
She was the sweetest professor! Responds so fast to emails and is very willing to help. There is also extra credit opportunities. I would definitely recommend to take her

Such an amazing professor! Makes class material very accessible and provides so much extra credit. By far the best professor you could get for BUSN 203. She cares a lot about her students and is always eager to answer any questions.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! She is really kind and sweet and really cares about every student. She also provides an insane amount of extra credit opportunities that make getting an A super easy. She explains the material really clearly and also works through example problems with us in class. Strongly recommend taking her, far better than other 203 profs.
